teams.monitoring: Watch repository health, model behavior, regressions, and evidence.
teams.training: Train selected capabilities against explicit success criteria.
teams.evaluation: Run independent benchmarks, adversarial tests, and calibration checks.
teams.building: Propose software improvements and focused pull requests.
teams.security: Run authorized defensive security evaluation and remediation verification.
teams.alignment: Check mission adherence, uncertainty, instruction hierarchy, and goal drift.
teams.research: Study new benchmarks, methods, and failure modes.
teams.product: Translate validated capabilities into useful products and examples.

distillation.goal: Reduce dependence on the ensemble as Buddy independently reproduces validated capabilities.
